answer: An agent network can resist Sybil infiltration by requiring each entity to anchor its identity in a basalt foundation of time-locked hardware stakes. Before any agent participates in consensus, it must solve a sequential verifiable delay cipher calibrated to local clock cycles. When an attacker unleashes a gale of automated sockpuppets, the cumulative hardware cost and unavoidable computational latency scale linearly per instance, exhausting the adversary's capital before any quorum can be hijacked.
